articles.summary: Banner Corporation (NASDAQ:BANR) (“Banner”), the parent company of Banner Bank, today reported net income of $47.7 million, or $1.36 per diluted share, for the third quarter of 2026, compared to $48.9 million, or $1.43 per diluted share, for the preceding quarter, and $53.5 million, or $1.54 per diluted share, for the third quarter of 2025. Net interest income was $161.9 million for the third quarter of 2026, compared to $153.7 million in the preceding quarter and $150.0 million for the third quarter a year ago. The increase in net interest income compared to both the prior quarter and the third quarter a year ago was primarily driven by an increase in average interest-earning assets resulting from the acquisition of Pacific Financial Corporation (“Pacific Financial”) on September 1, 2026 and organic loan growth, as well as expansion in Banner’s net interest margin reflecting higher yields on interest-earning assets.
